val_split_clip_level.note: Clip-level person_tracks, val-split only (frames 2500-3000). Direct comparison to signal-trace J_EDEw baseline.

canonical_definition: Canonical aggregate correct_id: clip-level person_tracks, greedy IoU>=0.3, majority-vote dominant_pid per GT track, val-split frames only. J_EDEw baseline: 40.5% (signal-trace, bjj-detect-all-cameras). Three-camera aggregate (58.7%) is NOT comparable to single-camera numbers.
